observations: Single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic sheeting.
Yellow turn signal section visible at the top of the unit.
Lens surface is hazy with glare and possible condensation under the plastic.
Watermark text "HONDA AND ACURA" overlaid on the image, not embossed on the part itself.
No readable part number, model badge, or manufacturer logo visible on the headlight housing.
Item resting on a rough concrete or dirt surface.

claims.claim: Seller offers body, engine and suspension parts for all Honda, Acura and Toyota car and SUV models.
claims.evidence: One photo cannot prove inventory across engine, suspension, or all vehicle models.

claims.claim: This headlight is for Honda or Acura (implied by photo watermark).
claims.evidence: Watermark in photo 0 is not a part marking and does not prove fitment or brand.

risks.risk: Headlight may not work (bulbs, ballast, wiring, or seals failed).
risks.proof: Video or photo of the headlight illuminated when connected to power.

risks.risk: Lens may be cracked, hazy, or damaged beneath the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens surface without plastic glare.

risks.risk: Fitment to a specific Honda, Acura, or Toyota model and year is unproven.
risks.proof: Photo of any part number sticker or stamp on the housing, plus exact model/year fitment from seller.

risks.risk: Mounting tabs, adjusters, or back housing may be broken.
risks.proof: Photo of the back housing showing connector and mounting points.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the headlight showing connector and mounting tabs.
Close-up of the lens without plastic wrap glare.
Photo of any part number or model stamp on the housing.
Video of the headlight turned on.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working with unknown fitment even though function and compatibility are unproven.
